d: Gil needs to get his hair cut before picture day.

st: Bubble Duckies!
d: Molly, Gil and a duckling named Beep help a family of ducks that are lost in a storm cloud.

d: The Guppies must move fast when a herd of cows wanders onto the train tracks.

d: The Bubble Guppies learn about outer space.

d: City-slicker umbrella sellers Molly and Gil set up shop in the Amazon rainforest.
